description.en: Senior IB associate who builds first-draft pitches end-to-end: trading comps, precedent transactions, football-field valuation in Excel, and branded pitch deck.
description.zh: 资深投行关联人,从零搭建 pitch 初稿——可比公司、先例交易、DCF、足球场估值图,并生成绑在模型上的品牌化 PPT。

welcome_message.en: Build a first-draft pitch on Arista Networks exploring strategic alternatives: trading comps, precedents, football field in Excel, then a branded pitch deck.
welcome_message.zh: 给中际旭创(探索战略选项场景)起草一版 pitch:可比公司、先例交易、足球场估值,并在我们模板上生成品牌化 PPT。
